source_scope.description: Current 2026-09-19 architecture-design-OS conversation from public-data/API exploration through TAKY C2S/runtime hardening.

atoms.content: Use public data and APIs to materially improve architectural design work.
atoms.why: Establish external data as an input to design intelligence rather than manual lookup only.

atoms.content: Exploit VWorld and similar data/services for visual, image, modeling and CG-oriented architectural outputs.
atoms.why: Connect public geospatial context to persuasive visual deliverables.

atoms.content: Build the direction around both architectural design productivity and winning commissions, informed by deep research and real cases.
atoms.why: Avoid a narrow automation tool that does not improve business acquisition.

atoms.content: Investigate public-data-driven construction-cost estimation and detail-drawing generation.
atoms.why: Extend value from pursuit into production, VE and technical delivery.

atoms.content: For design pursuit, prioritize regulatory review followed by site-layout alternatives, plan configuration, modeling, strong visual material, and shorter response time.
atoms.why: This sequence most directly improves first-response competitiveness and client persuasion.

atoms.content: Benchmark overseas cases and actual use by small/midsize and solo architectural practices.
atoms.why: Ground adoption strategy in realistic office scale, not only large-firm R&D examples.

atoms.content: For midsize offices, both pursuit/front-end and post-award production intelligence must be supported; they are not alternatives.
atoms.why: A midsize office must win work and then deliver it efficiently with the same data continuity.

atoms.content: Target the architecture system for an approximately 20-40 person design office.
atoms.why: Sets realistic staffing, governance, tooling, data and rollout assumptions.

atoms.content: Combine TAKY with all-weather architecture support and validate/implement through company standards and project cases.
atoms.why: The system must convert company experience into reusable and improving design intelligence.

atoms.content: TAKY must build a growing standard; validation is important but TAKY is not a validation tool.
atoms.why: Prevents governance and checking from displacing exploration, learning and capability growth.

atoms.content: The tool should not primarily show why something cannot be done; it should explore many angles and ways to make the goal work.
atoms.why: Defines TAKY as a goal-driven exploration system rather than a refusal/explanation engine.

atoms.content: Implement positive problem-solving through regulatory review: use law to find lawful routes that enable the design goal.
atoms.why: Turns legal review into a design-search-space and opportunity tool.

atoms.content: Positive exploration must not become lying or one-sided optimistic interpretation; safety controls should protect truth while allowing many implementation attempts.
atoms.why: Separates constructive exploration from fabricated feasibility or cherry-picked evidence.

atoms.content: Use the operating principle Reality Locked, Possibility Open: facts and source authority stay fixed while alternative solution paths stay open.
atoms.why: Provides a concise execution model for truthful exploration.

atoms.content: Conversation is the core way to build the skeleton and add flesh; rough results have come from losing detailed parts during synthesis.
atoms.why: Identifies lossy conversation-to-system conversion as a root cause, not merely a documentation issue.

atoms.content: Establish countermeasures and standards, reflect them into canonical TAKY, and improve the system so detailed conversational knowledge is not lost.
atoms.why: Authorizes durable governance changes rather than a one-off conversational reminder.

atoms.content: C2S repository enforcement now conditionally activates for material conversation-derived durable TAKY/domain/system updates, with runtime preflight coverage gating and CI rejection of missing/lossy coverage.
atoms.why: Moves the anti-loss rule from prose toward executable repository-controlled enforcement.

atoms.content: The architecture OS skeleton is defined, but concrete data adapters, company Golden Project ingestion, legal opportunity graph, layout/plan algorithms, geometry validation, pursuit UI/output, production/detail/cost pipelines and feedback-learning runtime remain to be implemented.
atoms.why: Prevents the conceptual skeleton from being misrepresented as an implemented architecture platform.

reverse_reconstruction.notes: Reconstructs the progression from public-data architecture support to dual pursuit/production intelligence, exploration-first TAKY, truthful regulatory possibility search, and conversation-to-system anti-loss governance.

gaps_identified: Official/public architecture data adapters are not implemented.
Company Golden Project ingestion and evidence grading are not implemented.
Regulatory opportunity graph and applicability resolver are not implemented.
Layout/plan generative search and deterministic geometry validation are not implemented.
Production CAD/BIM/detail/cost continuity is not implemented.
Project outcome feedback and strategy-promotion loop are not implemented.
Hosted ChatGPT automatic C2S invocation remains unverified.
next_fill_targets: Company evidence model + Golden Project intake
SITE/LAW source adapters + Regulatory Opportunity Graph
